description: List a directory in a sandbox, including dotfiles (.git, .env, .gitignore) by default — set include_hidden false to omit them.

include_hidden.description: Include dot-prefixed entries (default true). The data plane omits them unless asked, which hides .git/.env from a listing.

session_id.description: Sandbox session id (UUID), from tenki_create_sandbox or tenki_list_sandboxes.

name: tenki_list_files
